description_full: Hapvida Participações e Investimentos S.A., together with its subsidiaries, operates in the healthcare sector in Brazil. It sells health insurance plans through its own clinical, outpatient, and hospital networks, as well as dental plans through an accredited network. Hapvida Participações e Investimentos S.A. was founded in 1979 and is headquartered in Fortaleza, Brazil.
ceo_bio: Mr. Luccas Augusto Adib | Statutory Chief Executive Officer & Member of Executive Board
financial_summary: Hapvida Participações e Investimentos S.A. is a small-cap financial services business with a $603M market cap on $5.7B of annual revenue.
The top line has compounded at +7% over the past three years, a respectable pace for a business of this size.

Returns on capital run at 3% against a 13% cost of capital, which means the business is destroying value with every dollar it reinvests, and 12% gross margins are typical of commodity economics where competitors can replicate the product cheaply.
The business throws off $380M in free cash flow — roughly 7 cents on every revenue dollar, which is the owner-earnings figure that actually belongs to shareholders.
On the balance sheet, debt is moderate at 2.2× net debt/EBITDA, serviceable in normal conditions but worth watching through a downturn, and thin 0.7× interest coverage leaves no room for a bad year.

Management returns a meaningful 10.9% of market cap to owners through dividends and buybacks, a strong signal of disciplined capital allocation, and profit capture is only 0.2× the fair share, suggesting no structural edge inside its industry.
